headline: 1 failing test(s) indicate a real implementation bug; human review required

classifications.rationale: The subclass instances contain '(' and '()', respectively, so their required results are False and True. The candidate instead processes the replacement characters supplied by the overridden __iter__, producing the opposite results.
classifications.contract_basis: The contract explicitly accepts str subclasses and requires evaluating the brackets in the string using the same matching rules (acceptance criterion 12). An unmatched '(' is unbalanced; '()' is balanced.

modules.corrected_notes: No test correction is appropriate: the failing test exposes incorrect evaluation of accepted str subclass inputs.
